THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF A.G. PAPALIOLIOS RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT GROTINS, TODD $9,009.00 PRINCIPAL, $115.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $9,124.00, DEFENDANT SHALL PAY PLAINTIFF A.G. PAPALIOLIOS.
